summary_1line: Pandu marries Madri, conquers many kingdoms in a grand campaign, returns victorious to Hastinapura, distributes wealth, and later retires to the forest with Kunti and Madri.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma presents vast treasures and elephants while Salya ceremonially gives his ornamented sister Madri in marriage to Pandu.
Pandu stands triumphant in his chariot amid a massive army of elephants, horses, and banners as defeated kings bow and offer tribute.
Pandu walks through Himalayan forest hills with Kunti and Madri beside him, bow and arrows in hand, like a royal elephant with two mates.
